reference_sources: Shadow of the Demon Lord Core Rules

castings_matrix.comment: Castings allocations sourced explicitly from Occult Philosophy Rank Tables

human.name: Human
human.traits: Languages: Common Tongue plus either 1 additional language or a random starting profession. Versatile: When creating your character, increase one starting attribute score by 1.

changeling.name: Changeling
changeling.traits: Immune: Disease, Charmed, Diseased. Iron Vulnerability: Contact with iron removes Spell Defense and deals 1 damage. Shadowsight: See in dark areas within short range. Steal Identity: You can use an action to change your appearance to match any humanoid creature you have seen.

clockwork.name: Clockwork
clockwork.traits: Immune: Poison damage; diseased, fatigued, poisoned conditions. Immune: Disease, Poison, Asleep. Mechanical Body: Flat Defense 13. Cannot swim. Key: You have a key. When it runs down, you become an object. If wound up again, you reboot. Object Form: If inactive, Defense becomes 5 and Speed is 0.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.traits: Darksight: See in total darkness within medium range. Hated Creature: +1 boon on attacks against troglodytes, goblins, orcs. Robust Constitution: Take half damage from poison, +1 boon to resist poison.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.traits: Immune: Disease, Charmed, Diseased. Iron Vulnerability: Contact with iron deals 1 damage. Shadowsight. Sneaky baseline: +1 boon to hide/sneak.

orc.name: Orc
orc.traits: Shadowsight. Blood Rage: When injured, attacks deal +1d6 damage. Corruption: Starts with 1 Corruption.

elf.name: Elf
elf.traits: Immune: Disease, Charmed, Diseased. Shadowsight. Spell Defense: Take half damage from spells, +1 boon to resist spells. Bewitching Presence. Iron Vulnerability: Contact with iron removes Spell Defense and deals 1 damage.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.traits: Immune: Disease, Charmed, Diseased. Iron Vulnerability: Contact with iron deals 1 damage. Shadowsight. Frenzy: When taking damage, gain Frenzied trait (+1 boon on attacks and deal +1d6 damage with melee weapons for 1 round).

pixie.name: Pixie
pixie.traits: Size 1/8. Flutter Flight: Can fly. Naturally Invisible: Invisible to creatures unless they have Intellect 7 or lower or 5+ Insanity. Shadowsight. Iron Vulnerability: Contact with iron deals 1 damage. Wee: Small profile rules. Dilate: Increase Size to 1/2 as an action.

none.name: Level 0 (No Path)
none.description: A simple commoner trying to survive in a dark, decaying world.
none.features: Starting professions, baseline equipment, no magical talent.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Tough, martial specialists trained in weapons, tactics, and survival.
warrior.features: Weapon Training (rolls weapon attacks with 1 boon), Combat Expertise (once per round when you get a success on an attack roll, deal +1d6 damage).

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Cunning survivors, thieves, and skirmishers who rely on luck, agility, and tricks.
rogue.features: Trickery (deal +1d6 damage on weapon attacks made with 1 boon), Roguish Talent (choose magic path or combat skirmishing).

priest.name: Priest
priest.description: Devoted holy servants who manifest miracles, healing, and divine protection.
priest.features: Shared Power (discover 1 tradition, learn 2 spells), Divine Protection (+1 bonus to Defense if unarmored).

magician.name: Magician
magician.description: Scholarly students of the arcane who master spells and magic traditions.
magician.features: Arcane Magic (discover 2 traditions, learn 3 spells), Spell Recovery (recover expended castings once per day as an action).

armory_catalog.name: Dagger / Knife
armory_catalog.specs: Damage: 1d3 • Off Hand • Finesse, Thrown, Range (Short)

armory_catalog.name: Bow
armory_catalog.specs: Damage: 1d6 • Two Handed • Range (Long), Uses Arrows

armory_catalog.name: Crossbow
armory_catalog.specs: Damage: 2d6 • Two Handed • Range (Long), Reload, Uses Bolts

armory_catalog.name: Greatsword / Maul
armory_catalog.specs: Damage: 3d6 • Two Handed • Cumbersome • Requires Strength 13+

armory_catalog.name: Hard Leather Armor
armory_catalog.specs: Defense Base Value: Agility + 2 • Requires Strength 11+

armory_catalog.name: Mail Armor
armory_catalog.specs: Defense Set Parameter: 15 • Medium Armor Rules • Requires Strength 13+

armory_catalog.name: Full Plate Armor
armory_catalog.specs: Defense Set Parameter: 18 • Heavy Armor Rules • Requires Strength 15+

spells_sample.name: Shimmering Wall
spells_sample.desc: Area: Shapeable line 5yd long, 2yd tall. Imposes 2 banes on attack rolls made against targets behind the area.

spells_sample.name: Uplifting Step
spells_sample.desc: Duration: 1 min. Swirls around feet. Ignore difficult terrain; move across liquid or open spaces as solid ground.

spells_sample.name: Wind Disk
spells_sample.desc: Duration: 1 min. Grants +2 bonus to Defense. Can use action/triggered action to hit targets within reach for 1d6+1 damage.

spells_sample.name: Gale Force
spells_sample.desc: Area: Cone 10yd long. Blasts objects and creatures back. Targets make Strength challenge or take 2d6 damage and fly back 1d6 yards.

spells_sample.name: Preservation
spells_sample.desc: Target: Size 1 or smaller object. Object will not decay, rot, or spoil for 10 days. Target takes half damage.

spells_sample.name: Venomous Dart
spells_sample.desc: Concoct poison for up to 5 darts. Hit targets must succeed Strength challenge or take 1d3+1 poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute.

spells_sample.name: Brew Liquid Courage
spells_sample.desc: Concoct potion. Drinking creature makes all Intellect and Willpower challenge rolls with 1 boon, immune to frightened for 1 hour.

spells_sample.name: Acidic Blast
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 creature or object. Deal 4d6 damage. Acid melts armor: target takes permanent -1 to Defense if wearing armor.

spells_sample.name: Unlock Potential
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 creature reached. Target makes all attack and challenge rolls with 2 boons for 1 round.

spells_sample.name: Growth
spells_sample.desc: Duration: 1 min. Double size. +2 Strength, Speed +2, +1 boon on Strength challenge/attacks, melee weapon deals +1d6 damage.

spells_sample.name: Spider Climb
spells_sample.desc: Duration: 1 hour. Climb walls and ceilings. Speed is unaffected, no challenge roll needed.

spells_sample.name: Augmented Strike
spells_sample.desc: Trigger: You make a weapon attack. Strike deals +1d6 damage, or +2d6 if critical.

spells_sample.name: Swift Attack
spells_sample.desc: Action: You make two weapon attacks, each with 1 bane. Both attacks must be resolved.

spells_sample.name: Combat Command
spells_sample.desc: Trigger: An ally within 10 yards makes an attack. The ally makes the attack with 2 boons, and if successful, deals +1d6 damage.

spells_sample.name: Entropic Shield
spells_sample.desc: Duration: 1 min. Chaotic field causes attacks against you to have 1 bane. If an attack misses, roll d6: on 6, the attack hits another adjacent creature.

spells_sample.name: Warp Space
spells_sample.desc: Target: 2 creatures within 10yd. Switch the positions of the targets. Targets can resist with Agility challenge.

spells_sample.name: Hex
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 creature within 10yd. Target makes all attribute rolls with 1 bane for 1 minute. Can resist with Willpower challenge.

spells_sample.name: Pain
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 creature within 5yd. Target takes 2d6 damage and is impaired for 1 round (Intellect challenge to resist).

spells_sample.name: Life Drain
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 living creature. Deal 2d6 damage and heal yourself for the same amount. Target resists with Strength.

spells_sample.name: Slay
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 creature with Health 20 or less. Target dies instantly. If higher health, takes 4d6 damage instead.

spells_sample.name: Stone Shield
spells_sample.desc: Trigger: You are attacked. A wall of stone rises to block the attack, granting you +4 Defense against this attack.

spells_sample.name: Tremor
spells_sample.desc: Area: Radius 5yd. Ground shakes. All creatures on the ground make Agility challenge or fall prone.

spells_sample.name: Flame Dart
spells_sample.desc: Ranged attack. Deal 1d6 damage. Ignites flammable objects. On natural 20, deals +1d6 fire damage.

spells_sample.name: Fireball
spells_sample.desc: Area: Sphere 5yd radius. Deal 4d6 fire damage to all creatures and objects in the area (Agility halves damage).

spells_sample.name: Disguise
spells_sample.desc: Duration: 1 hour. Change your appearance. Creatures checking your appearance must roll Intellect against your Intellect/Willpower.

spells_sample.name: Invisibility
spells_sample.desc: Duration: 1 min. Target creature becomes invisible. Ends if target attacks or casts a spell.

spells_sample.name: Cure
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 creature. Remove diseased or poisoned condition.

spells_sample.name: Heal
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 creature. Target heals damage equal to its healing rate (Health / 4).

spells_sample.name: Animate Dead
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 corpse within reach. Animate the corpse into a zombie or skeleton under your control for 1 hour.

spells_sample.name: Dark Light
spells_sample.desc: Creates a beam of shadow that acts as darklight (visible only to shadowsight/darksight) or blinds a target.

spells_sample.name: Shadow Walk
spells_sample.desc: Duration: 1 min. Teleport up to 10 yards from one shadow to another as a move action.

spells_sample.name: Inspiring Anthem
spells_sample.desc: Allies within 5 yards gain +1 boon on attack and challenge rolls for 1 round.

spells_sample.name: Thunderclap
spells_sample.desc: Deals 1d3 damage to all adjacent creatures and deafens them for 1 round.

spells_sample.name: Lightning Bolt
spells_sample.desc: Line 10yd long. Deal 3d6 lightning damage (Agility halves).

spells_sample.name: Freeze
spells_sample.desc: Target: 1 creature or volume of water. Freezes water. Creature takes 1d6 cold damage and Speed is halved (Strength resists).
